adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members`, the diff sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then directly calls `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no clamping/validation to ensure `limit`/`offset` are >= 0, so a request with `?limit=-1` or `?offset=-10` can flow into ActiveRecord/PostgreSQL `LIMIT`/`OFFSET` and plausibly raise a DB error (500) on this non-admin/public endpoint. The issue is diff-grounded and the finding is accurate.
